pr_title: fix(python): set null_count on categorical append

issue_context.title: `Series.null_count()` for Categorical types only considers the first chunk
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

with pl.StringCache():
    s1 = pl.Series(["", ""], dtype=pl.Categorical)
    s2 = pl.Series([None, "", ""], dtype=pl.Categorical)

s = pl.concat([s1, s2], rechunk=False)

print(s.null_count())  # 0
```


### Log output

_No response_

### Issue description

Caught by parametric tests [here](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/actions/runs/6592015533/job/17911807871).

Introduced by #11889

`null_count` is wrong for chunked Series of type Categorical.

### Expected behavior

Output for example should be `1`.

### Installed versions

main branch
